rationale: The candidate reads coherently across all four views as one dominant stepped/split-wing mass, so it clears the multi-view coherence gate. The parcel is respected without merely filling the boundary, and the blue access edge is answered by a visible ground-level split/entry seam rather than a sealed face. The silhouette is not generic stair-terracing; it has some capacity-bearing stepped logic, though the section remains more formal than program-deep. The strongest quality is hierarchy: a compact main body with a secondary carved/split condition at ground and a clear upper mass. The main weakness is that the public void is present but modest, and the section still feels a bit abstract for neighborhood living rather than explicitly activated by a deeper court or terrace sequence. Overall this is a plausible neighborhood-living massing with solid repair integrity and decent precedent resonance.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A low-rise, winged composition organized around a readable central void and connecting circulation can support a neighborhood program while keeping the ground legible.
